[Intro]

[Verse 1]
[Am]You see
life in these ruins
But I
find it hard to be-
[Em]lieve
In places where your
[Am]heart bleeds
So hard to find the
space
Where we can lie down
[Em]quietly

[Chorus]
[C]Feelings change in
a one moment
On the way to
our place of
[Am]birth
[C]Words are slowly turning
to the snow
On the way to
our place of
[Am]birth
[G]Cold winds are shaking
the high trees
And it's so easy
to for-
[F]get our names

[Interlude]
[Am]
[Em]
[Am]
[Em]

[Verse 2]
[Am]You see
life in these ruins
But I
find it hard to be-
[Em]lieve
Together we can
[Am]run far
Together we will
fall
Together we will
[Em]fade away

[Chorus]
[C]Words are slowly turning
to the snow
On the way to
our place of
[Am]birth
[C]Feelings change in
a one moment
On the way to
our place of
[Am]birth
[G]Cold winds are shaking
the high trees
And it's so easy
to for-
[F]get our names

[Verse 3]
[G]Love is a perfect
ache And I
hear the sound of
piano when you are
[F]calling me

[Chorus]
[C]Feelings change in
a one moment
On the way to
our place of
[Am]birth
[C]Words are slowly turning
to the snow
On the way to
our place of
[Am]birth
